summary: Open gravel car park beside a community garden, parkland and playing fields.
reasons: Gravel lot with room for a van

drivers.seclusion: Surrounded by parkland, garden plots, trees and fields; only sheds and garden buildings nearby.
drivers.access_and_room: Formed gravel lot of about 25 by 40 m with marked bays and a track in; plenty of room.
drivers.traffic: Low-use park car park, no through road.
drivers.convention: Public car park, access yes, no fee; a few cars parked in both images.

flags: Low-lying: about 2.3 m elevation, Toowong Creek 48 m away
Mapped gates nearby have a way round and don't block access
Rail line not close but suburb noise possible
sun_shade: Open in the middle; trees shade the east side in the morning.
cannot_judge: Evening closing of the car park

best_section.where: Western side of the community garden car park, away from the access track
